ctx.x: But you don't have to become, you know, some people think of a quart a day as somebody sprawled in the gutter. There are lots of people who drink a quart a day. A fellow, a composer just died two weeks ago from doing just that thing. Hall Overton was his name.

He's been associated with jazz. He was a white man from the Mid-West. But he's been in New York for some twenty years and he orchestrated some of Monk's Town Hall things. He did a concert at Lake Tahoe and he'd been a private composition teacher for a long time. And also teaches at Julliard ego. And a couple of weeks, I got a 'phone call from his girl saying that he wanted to see
me and named (a couple of his).... I didn't know him very well, but he'd been on the, a couple of boards. I think he was on the National Endowment Board. I think he was, do you know him?
